title.en: Pieces of a dismantled old staircase

alt.tr: Seramik zeminde sökülmüş eski ahşap merdiven kirişleri, basamak parçaları ve dökülmüş toprak
alt.en: Dismantled old timber stair stringers and tread pieces on a ceramic floor, with spilled soil

caption.tr: Eski merdiven söküldüğünde geriye kirişler ve kırık basamaklar kalmış. Zeminde toprak birikmiş.
caption.en: Once the old stairs came apart, stringers and broken treads were left. Soil has collected on the floor.
